name: Hokkan Limited
summary: Hokkan Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the container, filling, machinery production, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells a wide variety of containers, including metal containers, such as food cans; plastic containers, such as PET bottles; and general-purpose containers, such as art cans and spray cans; and molds and processes synthetic resins. It also manufactures soft drinks and alcoholic beverages, dairy products and confectionaries, retort pouch food, and agricultural products; and manufacturing and sales of packaging materials.
